name: Yungang Grottoes
description: Carved into a sandstone cliff about 16 km west of Datong in Shanxi Province, the Yungang Grottoes are one of China's great Buddhist sculpture sites. Work began in the 5th century under the Northern Wei dynasty. The cliff face holds 252 caves and some 51,000 statues, from giant seated Buddhas to tiny carved niches, and the Five Caves by the monk Tan Yao are the highlight.
